data.text: “I’d prefer 10 tons each. Luke, you’re part of this village’s livelihood now too—you shouldn’t have to go without income to earn your place. Equal shares give us a simple agreement we can keep month after month, with 50 tons left to replenish the lake. I commit to catching 10 tons this month if we all agree. Let’s review our catches together afterward and adjust the limit if the lake ever starts a month below 100 tons. Luke, would you support equal shares?”
